reviewNotes: Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1920, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The last verse is printed after the score in the source, not under the notes. The Open Hymnal's own source: Hymnal and Liturgies of the Moravian Church, 1920 Hymn 471. setting very similar to "The Coronation Hymnal", American Baptist Publication Society, 1894 Hymn 182.
